units.source_text: 当然不能断言没有危险。

en.t: Of course, he could not say for certain that there was no danger.

units.source_text: 而且，说不定再过三十分钟，他们的态度会急剧变化。

en.t: Besides, in another thirty minutes, their attitude might suddenly change.

units.source_text: 譬如，有县里政府官员来调查的事。

en.t: For example, there was the matter of a prefectural government official coming to investigate.

units.source_text: 一开始，村里那老头还误把他当成那个官员，

en.t: At first, the old man from the village had even mistaken him for that official,

units.source_text: 脸上现出明显的警惕神色。

en.t: and a clear look of wariness had appeared on his face.

units.source_text: 看来政府官员的调查是最近的事。

en.t: It seemed that the government official's investigation had happened quite recently.

units.source_text: 假如真的来了，村里意见不一，肯定掩盖不住他的事，

en.t: If the official really came, the village would be divided, and they surely could not keep his situation hidden,

units.source_text: 也许他们会早早死心不再囚禁他了呢。

en.t: so perhaps they would give up early and stop keeping him prisoner.

units.source_text: 然而，同样不能保证这三十分钟不会拖到半年或者一年以后。

en.t: However, there was likewise no guarantee that those thirty minutes would not stretch into half a year or even a year.

units.source_text: 三十分钟和一年可是一半对一半的准确率呀，

en.t: Thirty minutes and one year were, after all, odds of fifty-fifty,

units.source_text: 他已经再也不想打赌了。

en.t: and he no longer wanted to gamble at all.
